key_insight: A systematic continued-pretraining recipe and carefully balanced long-context data mixtures enable a 7B vision-language model to scale from 32K to 128K context length and generalize beyond 128K, improving sustained reasoning over ultra-long inputs.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of practical training recipes and data-mixture strategies for scaling LVLM context windows, which limits reliable long-document, long-video, and multi-turn tool-use capabilities.
method: Continued pretraining of a 7B LVLM with progressively longer context windows (32K → 128K) using mixed-length inputs.
Design and balance of a targeted data mixture across short, medium, and ultra-long sequences to prevent forgetting and encourage generalization.
Systematic evaluation of generalization beyond 128K and practical training recommendations (curriculum, data proportions, and evaluation protocol).
impact: Provides actionable recipes for ML practitioners to train LVLMs that handle ultra-long contexts, unlocking robust long-document understanding, video analysis, and sustained agentic workflows without ad-hoc data engineering.
visual_elements: Progression diagram: timeline showing context window growth (32K → 128K → beyond) with curriculum stages
Line chart: model performance (accuracy/QA/consistency) vs. context length to show scaling and generalization
Pie/bar chart: composition of the training data mixture (short/medium/ultra-long proportions)
Application icons/scene panel: examples of use cases (long document, multi-minute video, multi-turn tool agent)
paper_title: Training Long-Context Vision-Language Models Effectively with Generalization Beyond 128K Context
paper_authors: Zhaowei Wang, Lishu Luo, Haodong Duan, Weiwei Liu, Sijin Wu
